I’m Dipesh Mishra, a software engineer and founder who enjoys connecting the dots between an ambitious idea and a working product.

My work moves across interfaces, mobile apps, AI agents, and cloud infrastructure. I like understanding the whole system, then making each part feel simple for the people using it.

From patent marketplaces to food-ordering apps, I’ve worked on products where engineering and real-world needs meet. That’s the space I keep coming back to.
